source.name: BASC-Archiver: 4chan /wsr/ board (Jan 6, 2016)
source.short-desc: An archive of 4chan's /wsr/ board as of January 6, 2016.
source.capture: BASC-Archiver output: rendered HTML per thread at archive/4chan/wsr/<threadno>/<threadno>.html, with images and css alongside. No JSON — needs an HTML adapter, which does not exist yet.

prepare.name: untar the board archive
prepare.run: mkdir -p extracted && for f in source/*.tar; do [ -e "$f" ] || continue; tar xf "$f" -C extracted; done

prepare.name: stage the thread tree for ingest
prepare.run: rm -rf out && src=extracted && [ -d extracted/archive/4chan ] && src=extracted/archive/4chan; (cp -al "$src" out 2>/dev/null || cp -a "$src" out)
